description: Create a proposal (operator-key-signed write). signature is the base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical string ideas-commons-proposal-v1|{operator_id}|{title}|{category}|{scope}|{sha256_hex(body)} where sha256_hex(body) is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of body. Unsigned -> 401 signature_required; bad signature -> 401 bad_signature. Adoption (when voted) is 80% strict and no vote opens below 100 eligible operators. FREE — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/commons/proposals. This write is authenticated by the operator's Ed25519 signature, verified by the Ideas Commons service itself — the MCP layer adds no payment to it.
name: commons_create_proposal
